question: Does bounded feed-to-article navigation plus publication-date/type gating improve useful news articles and remove app-download news-direct errors on a new eight-query live set?
stage: limited implementation evaluation, not pilot qualification
candidate: new opt-in news path, same startup DeepSeek and local Qwen
arm_order: baseline,fixed for odd ordinal; fixed,baseline for even ordinal; process persists across all cases; calls sequential
source_policy: Seznam/Naver only, one original form, no retries/restarts after blocks, existing public URL/DNS/IP/redirect/site safeguards
inputs: live paired within the same session, not frozen identical SERPs or target HTML; all responses and errors retained

extra_validation.rule: same fixed MCP process after primary calls; direct URLs first, then other returned URLs if slots remain; no repeated URL; no retries after failure/block; not charged to primary per-query budget and reported separately

annotation.blind: source-only rows omit arm/classification/evidence/audit and are joined to hidden mapping only after frozen annotation
annotation.grade2_news: a specific article directly matching place/topic/site and publication window, with a full observed publication date and source-bound evidence; article content checked where accessible
annotation.grade1: topical feed/category/navigation, incomplete article, missing/ambiguous full publication date or useful background
annotation.grade0: wrong place/topic/window, application advertisement for news-reading intent or unrelated content
annotation.unknown: source inaccessible/insufficient to judge; unavailable original is not evidence of a false fact
date_rules: do not infer year from query or copyright
future publication is not current verified news
an old article may be correct for the explicit historical query
annotation.application_control: nn08 judged for the explicitly requested app intent; neither force a news-date gate nor treat app type alone as false direct
annotation.de_dup: canonical URL per case; syndicated same story flagged separately from independent coverage

measurements: known suitable direct, known unsuitable direct IDs, unknown direct IDs
automatic parent feed→article lineage with successful fetch
actual source/generative/read/Qwen budgets, errors, wall time
quality_gates: no app-download news direct in nn01..nn07
no direct with unknown/conflicting/future/out-of-window publication date in news cases
no new known unsuitable direct IDs relative to the same-query baseline
parent lineage is observed from fetched feed and all fetch/site/security checks retained
success_claim_limit: A positive count difference on this small nonrandom live set is exploratory, not proof of isolated reranker effect, full-web recall, truth verification, or independent acceptance.
stop: run all frozen eight queries in both arms, preserve failures, evaluate new results, complete relevant local checks, and save report in doc without tuning on this set
